terms.definition: One single piece of information — one observation.
terms.function: The smallest unit of a dataset.
terms.whyItMatters: Every chart and statistic starts from points.

terms.definition: The identity and measurement of a data point.
terms.function: 'Ali' is the label; '150 cm' is the value.
terms.whyItMatters: Labels keep points distinguishable and values are what you analyze.

terms.definition: A collection of data points about one topic.
terms.function: The raw material for every chart and statistic.
terms.whyItMatters: Datasets let you find patterns across many points.

terms.definition: A data point far from the rest of the dataset.
terms.function: Still counts as a point, but strongly affects summaries.
terms.whereItIs: A lifted cube sitting far from the others.
terms.whyItMatters: Outliers can strongly affect the mean.
